pages.text: The Reinforced Deepslate Pickaxe is a highly specialized tool designed for a single purpose: mining Reinforced Deepslate at very high speed. It is completely useless as a general-purpose pickaxe — it cannot mine stone, ores, or any other block efficiently.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: This pickaxe has been engineered to break Reinforced Deepslate blocks at the same speed a Diamond Pickaxe breaks regular stone. Against any other block, it behaves like a bare hand — extremely slow mining with no correct-tool bonus.

pages.title: Crafting Requirement
pages.text: To craft this pickaxe, you first need to obtain a Reinforced Deepslate block. In vanilla Minecraft, these blocks drop nothing when broken. This mod adds a special override: breaking a Reinforced Deepslate block with a Diamond Workhand Professional Improved Pickaxe will drop the block itself.

pages.title: Stats
pages.text:
Durability: 50,000
Mining Speed (Reinforced Deepslate): ~293
Mining Speed (other blocks): 1.0
Attack Damage: +4
Enchantability: 15
Repair: Netherite Ingots
